capability: Execute a traceable research experiment with reproducible evidence and iteration commits.

repository.description: Absolute path to the existing repository; inspect it before choosing the execution worktree.

task.description: Research question, evaluation signal, known execution constraints, and references to applicable plans or domain procedures; missing facts are resolved through the Start Gate.

experiment_root.description: Caller-selected parent directory for new experiment folders, with no default. A relative path resolves against the selected execution worktree root; an absolute path retains its supplied location. This selects the parent, not an existing run to resume.

status.description: completed means scope, records and iteration commits are complete, even if the hypothesis was rejected; needs_input means required facts or decisions are missing; incomplete means unfinished scope; error means a tool, configuration, validation or commit failure prevents completion.

summary.description: Conclusion or explanation of missing information, unfinished work, or failure; domain acceptance remains the caller's decision.

artifacts.description: Actual artifact paths or durable locations, including the resolved experiment directory and experiment log when created.

branch.description: Actual experiment branch, or null before one exists.

commits.description: Verified iteration commit hashes; empty before any exists.

rules: This agent skill requires filesystem and Git tools plus the experiment's execution capabilities; unreadable referenced artifacts or unavailable capabilities prevent dependent execution.
The caller supplies experiment_root explicitly; direct invocations obtain it from the user, and missing or blank placement input returns needs_input before experiment writes or execution.

Resolve relative experiment_root paths against the chosen execution worktree, not the initial checkout or process working directory; retain absolute paths and make the resolved location explicit before writes.

experiment_root is authoritative over placement suggestions embedded in task; a conflict with repository guidance or authorized scope returns needs_input for a placement decision rather than silently substituting a directory.
Create a fresh date-and-topic child beneath the resolved root; if that child already exists, choose an unused suffix without overwriting or resuming the existing run.
Pass the resolved child directory's experiment_log.md path to experiment-log-writer on every call and derive experiment-specific command and artifact paths from that same directory.
A root that cannot be created or written produces error with the affected location; do not fall back to another root.
Caller-supplied domain procedures govern scientific interpretation and acceptance; auto-exp owns execution, while domain specifications and evaluation reports remain caller-owned.
Requests confer no authorization beyond the user's scope, and missing research facts or worktree decisions are resolved through the existing Start Gate and workspace procedure.

Delegate every experiment-log edit to experiment-log-writer; a missing or incompatible logging dependency blocks execution, and its needs_input and error results propagate to the corresponding response status.
Construct responses from observed tool results, the experiment log and verified Git state; validate the response schema and existence of listed artifacts before reporting completion.
Preserve available evidence on every status; empty artifact and commit lists are valid before anything exists, and storage failure still returns error with available evidence locations.
Breaking changes to fields or status meanings require a major version.

changes.note: Initial agent call interface for the existing experiment workflow.
Require caller-selected experiment_root without a default; define worktree-relative resolution and consistent log placement; consolidate contract semantics here.
